argv: first point-in-time model; dry-run forward test, decision rule: 2,000 would-trade decisions

Operator-authorised live forward test, 2026-10-18. The market gates are expected to fail: measured this session on 54,100 live-recorded rows graded on the venue's own settlement, model_minus_market is +0.000338 [-0.000401,+0.001063], t=+0.92, and NEGATIVE per fold (4/8). The +0.0023 (t=4.8) figure that looks like an edge is against BACKFILLED quotes only; P&L splits +$3,493.94 backfill against -$55.03 live. This artifact is not promoted because it beats the price - it does not. It is promoted to forward-test three execution changes the same model showed are worth more than the forecast: maker entry (resting at the bid, zero fee, ~1.5-2pp/contract against a ~1.1-1.5pp model edge), the 35-65c dead band (that band alone lost $393 on live quotes), and a 5s quote-staleness bar. Money gates are computed over backfilled quotes and must be read as an upper bound. The up/down tilt is NOT fixed: live took 83 UP trades and zero DOWN over the four days to 2026-10-17.

Adds directional_tilt_abs (threshold 0.5pp, max). The deployed model runs +0.883pp more bullish than the price at t=+25.9 over 2,178 live windows, by one-sided sharpening (+1.705pp on UP favourites against -0.035pp on DOWN). Against a 1.5pp edge gate that makes the real hurdle ~0.6pp one way and ~2.4pp the other, which is why live traded 83 UP and zero DOWN over four days. The gate needs no outcomes, so it is measurable where every outcome-based statistic on the same sample is noise. Lock regenerated in the same change, 22 -> 23 gates.

Operator-authorised 2026-10-21. Kalshi-only quote sources (live_touch,live_ws,live,live_ws_replay,candles) with --peer-quote-sources all, chosen for PRICE VALIDITY rather than measured skill: the Predexon backfill is unbiased but 54x noisier, stamped a minute late and quantises the deci-cent tail grid to whole cents in ~27% of rows, so a model trained to beat it may not transfer to a book we can actually trade. Measured this session, the arm scores WORSE than all-sources (log_loss_skill +0.000353 vs +0.000399; model_minus_market +0.000183 vs +0.000383) and fails more gates, most of that from 5 folds instead of 7. The market gates are expected to fail: no arm beats the price (model_minus_market_p 0.21-0.23). Deployed alongside scripts/record_book_minutes, which supplies the six book_flow features that were NaN on every live decision under the previous artifact.

THREE changes, each measured. (1) MIGRATED PRICE BASIS: cfbenchmarks BRTI index plus the venue's own floor_strike, per C1, +0.0033 log loss at t +5.71 over 42 of 50 folds. The live path can now honour it: score_live passes the venue strike into build_windows BEFORE build_features, so all ten strike-derived features share one reference instead of the strike being patched onto the scored frame afterwards, where it reached only z_score. The trader is restarted onto --venue cfbenchmarks --strike-source venue immediately after this installs; until that restart the new artifact scores on the old basis, a ~1bp mismatch for at most one window. (2) SAMPLE REPAIR: the installed artifact trained on 18,797 rows with peer_quote_sources empty, so --quote-sources discarded the Polymarket gamma backfill and took most cross_venue rows with it; with --peer-quote-sources all and the implied_vol available_time repair the complete-cases sample is about 164k. (3) implied_vol DROPPED: its leave-one-out delta at ensemble_size 5 is +0.000017, inside the band of five independent noise draws (-0.000034 to -0.000007, |max| 0.000034), so it contributes nothing this design can measure, while costing 35% of the sample. cross_venue is KEPT although it also fails the pre-registered rule at t +2.63 against a 2.7 bar: its delta is 4.5x the noise floor and dropping it is a sample-versus-skill tradeoff that PREREG_ABLATION_20261022.md says needs its own test. The 2.7 threshold was NOT relaxed to admit it. vol_state, microstructure, offset and book_quote are all inside the noise band but constrain no rows, so they are kept rather than selected on noise. Bankroll is the measured shard-2 balance, 458.75.

Groups are book_quote, not market_state+book_flow: the 7 depth columns cannot exist before 2026-08-25 because the venue serves no historical order book, and under --complete-cases they pin training to the live era; the 4 quote columns are recoverable to 2025-12-10 from the venue's own candles. Standing operator policy, 2026-10-21: the Sunday retrain ALWAYS installs, so the model keeps absorbing new data. The gates are advisory and the operator reads them; they are not a blocker. Quote sources are Kalshi-only for price VALIDITY rather than measured skill - the Predexon backfill is unbiased but 54x noisier, stamped a minute late, and quantises the deci-cent tail grid to whole cents in ~27% of rows, so a model trained to beat it may not transfer to a book we can trade. It scores worse on the gates and that is accepted. --peer-quote-sources all keeps Polymarket intact: the source filter matches on the bare name and would otherwise discard the gamma backfill, which is a different pipeline, taking every cross_venue row with it.

LIVE-QUOTE-ONLY EXPERIMENT, operator decision 2026-10-28. Trained and graded only on the live recorded book (candles dropped from --quote-sources; --peer-quote-sources all retained so the Polymarket gamma backfill and every cross_venue row survive the filter). --start 2026-08-29 is the first day live coverage is complete: recording began 2026-08-25 at 5% and reached 100% on the 29th. --min-train-windows 1200 because at 500 the first fold had 396 scoreable rows against the 500 a shrinkage fit requires, and the run aborted. Rationale: every model before this was graded mostly against backfilled candle quotes -- Jan-Aug is ~100% candles, Sep-Oct ~99% live -- so its edge was never measured against an executable price on most of the sample. KNOWN COST, accepted: 5 folds against a min_folds of 6, log_loss_skill_p 0.218, realised_edge_lcb -1.755, overconfidence_abs 0.01889 against a 0.015 bar. Those are sample starvation at 7,413 windows and 1,196 trades, not evidence the forecast is bad, and the live sample grows about one fold a week. In its favour: n_halts 0 where every full-sample arm breached the bankroll floor, max drawdown 0.157 against 0.243, median fold drawdown 0.000. The incumbent 20261027T211836Z remains in models/.staging and can be reinstalled by copying it back over models/forecast.joblib.

MEANING FRAMING plus every other usable group, operator decision 2026-11-05, after the live-quote-only model underperformed at -83.10 over 237 settled trades. book_quote and book_depth are the QUOTE/DEPTH framing of the same columns and core/features.py refuses to combine them with book_flow and market_state: a half-swapped framing silently keeps every depth column and then reports no effect for a feature that was never removed. This run takes the MEANING framing, which is the one that had been switched off. Its stated reason -- the 7 depth columns cannot exist before 2026-08-25 because the venue serves no historical order book -- is moot now that training starts 2026-08-29 and is live-quote-only. Also adds market_price and time_of_day. EXCLUDED: index_proxy, which starts 2026-10-14 against a window from 2026-08-29 and under --complete-cases would truncate about 45 percent of the sample and risk dropping below min_folds 6; and noise through noise5, the random controls that measure the noise floor. For reference, book_depth alone was measured 2026-11-04 as free (identical 30.8 percent row retention) and worthless (fold-skill difference -0.000005, t=-0.06, better in 2 of 6 folds).

MEANING FRAMING, controls excluded. Operator decision 2026-11-05. Replaces 20261105T091152Z, which was installed an hour earlier with the same groups PLUS time_of_day and must not trade: its deployed_residual_scale was 0.00001, meaning the shipped artifact kept essentially none of its claimed correction and would trade as the bare baseline, and control_gain_share had gone 0.00000 to 0.19631, meaning hour-of-day carried about a fifth of the gain. time_of_day is the CONTROL that measures the noise floor; when the gain moves onto the ruler the measurement is broken rather than the market. Its legitimate content is already modelled twice -- the baseline carries a smoothed minute-of-day volatility factor and vol_state carries seasonal_ramp -- and on 68 days of training dow_sin and dow_cos see about ten of each weekday, enough to memorise and not to learn. Groups here are the meaning framing (book_flow, market_state) rather than the quote/depth framing (book_quote, book_depth), which core/features.py refuses to mix because a half-swapped framing silently keeps every depth column and reports no effect for a feature that was never removed. The meaning framing had been switched off because the depth columns cannot exist before 2026-08-25; that is moot now training starts 2026-08-29 and is live-quote-only. EXCLUDED: index_proxy, which starts 2026-10-14 and under --complete-cases would truncate about 45 percent of the window; and noise through noise5, the random controls.

Groups are book_quote, not market_state+book_flow: the 7 depth columns cannot exist before 2026-08-25 because the venue serves no historical order book, and under --complete-cases they pin training to the live era; the 4 quote columns are recoverable to 2025-12-10 from the venue's own candles. Standing operator policy, 2026-10-21: the Sunday retrain ALWAYS installs, so the model keeps absorbing new data. The gates are advisory and the operator reads them; they are not a blocker. BRTI end to end: venue bar series, venue strike and venue settlement, so bars, barrier and label are all the series the markets settle on. Coinbase bars misplaced the venue settlement on 184 of 6,009 windows (3.1%) against 1 for BRTI. Taker, not maker: resting saved 0.94pp/contract of fee and cost 1.85pp to adverse selection, and there is no exit path, so a resting order pays a market maker cost and earns none of the revenue. cross_venue and implied_vol are both out under --complete-cases: implied_vol holds 2,047 SOL fits against 50,924 for BTC and discarded nearly every SOL row, and pm_market_probability was the single largest dropper at 46,514 of 79,308 rows; without them coverage is 98.8% and folds even out to 1,953-1,992 windows. cross_venue was the only group producing tradeable disagreement (trade rate 1.48% against 0.04%) but that disagreement lost money (-0.53pp realised over 528 trades), and with a peer sampled every ~16s it is largely lagged momentum. The shipped shrinkage is the WALK-FORWARD median, not the refit own inner-holdout fit: the refit estimates it on ~10% of training windows and returned 0.00001 against a walk-forward 0.96-1.00, which makes the model emit the market price and refuse every trade. Standing operator policy: the Sunday retrain ALWAYS installs so the model keeps absorbing new data; the gates are advisory and the operator reads them.
